applicability: Admitting or rejecting solver configurations for lab fixtures by measurement instead of interpolation
Reconstructing total external support load for a closed measured body set
Diagnosing controllers that underestimate support because they read one local contact impulse
claim: For the exact L1.6 ten-body 1 kg-per-body stack fixture at 60 Hz across eight fresh Jolt spaces plus repeats, velocity/position solver configurations 2/4, 4/4, and 10/4 are rejected while 20/1, 20/2, 20/4, 20/8, and 40/4 are accepted, so the project's 20/4 sits inside the measured envelope. A changed solver setting takes effect only after ProjectSettings mutation, a process-boundary settings notification, and construction of a fresh World3D with a tagged excluded warm-up tick; mislabeled reuse of a cached space produced a plausible but wrong table that was removed. Independently, the raw predicted impulse at the bottom floor contact reported approximately 9.821 N while the expected and momentum-reconstructed whole-system support load was approximately 98.005 N, so a local raw contact impulse is not the external support load of a coupled system; the reconstructor recovers it from J_unknown = P_after - P_before - J_known and F_n = (J_unknown . n) / dt.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the L1.0-L1.7 contact-engine observations named by the exact source-pinned programs. L1.8 and the knowledge guard are supplementary constraints. It establishes no articulated load-bearing limb, standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, walking, accepted knowledge, automatic creature guidance, or per-foot allocation of reconstructed whole-system load.

programs.claim_scope: Exact solver cells are measured after the required settings/world lifecycle, and whole-system support is reconstructed separately from local contact transmission.

failure_boundaries: Does not permit interpolation or extrapolation to unmeasured solver configurations
Does not allocate the reconstructed load among multiple feet, toes, or contact sites
Does not cover articulated joints; the stack couples through contact only
Does not establish standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, or walking
mechanism: Jolt's project-settings listener updates its cache on settings_changed, and a Jolt space snapshots velocity and position step counts at construction, so only a fresh space after the notification runs the requested configuration. Contact impulses report local pair transmission, not system support: summing momentum change over every body isolates the unknown external impulse, which converts to a step-average normal load.

parameter_effects.change: decrease below the measured accepted cells
hinges_on: The fresh-space lifecycle actually applying the requested configuration
parameter_effects.mechanism: Too few velocity iterations under-resolve the coupled contact constraints of the ten-body stack

scope: Ten stacked unjointed 1 kg bodies on a static floor, 60 Hz, Godot 4.7 Jolt backend, one fresh SubViewport World3D per solver configuration after a settings-change notification boundary, exact measured solver cells only, whole-system momentum-balance reconstruction over all bodies with gravity as the known impulse.
title: Solver-step admission is exact-cell only and local raw contact impulse is transmission-blind in coupled stacks
unknowns: How the accepted solver envelope shifts for articulated chains and motors
How to attribute reconstructed external load to individual contact sites
Whether the rejected low-iteration cells fail identically across platforms
